Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent enemy sprite for the existing dark-fantasy game. Use the approved pixel-art technique and described style. Match chunky, stepped pixel blocks, dark warm near-black outlines, muted cream/bone, rust brown, antique brass and charcoal steel palette, and upper-left highlights. Single complete isolated creature/object, three-quarter battle view toward screen left, no environment or ground shadow. It should look drawn at roughly 112x140 logical pixels and enlarged with nearest-neighbor to about 1120x1400: hard square 10px blocks, 1–2 block outline, approximately 3–7 broad shade bands, no dithering or smooth shading. Use a small coherent palette (up to 32 colors). Fully transparent empty background, fully opaque sprite, no translucent effects or antialiased edges. No lettering, UI, border, watermark or labels. Do not add traits, props or weapons absent from the following source description. Weakness elements are metadata, not visual powers.
Source: design/enemies.json enemy bronze_altar; name 청동 제단의 화신; family 25 청동 문명; original grade boss; art grade boss. Exact appearance (authoritative Korean): 청동 제단에 바쳐진 사람들이 제단과 한 몸이 된 것. 제단의 불이 아직 꺼지지 않았다.
Source actions for pose or explicitly named equipment only: 제물 고르기, 청동 불길, 제단 부름.
ONE cohesive composite enemy sprite. Include exactly the multiple constituent figures or bodies stated in the source, fused or grouped as described; no lineup or separate variants. Keep the entire silhouette and all tips inside frame with generous transparent margins. No scenery, floor or detached background fragments. Any source inscriptions must be abstract tiny marks, never legible lettering. No new heraldry or invented decoration.
Faithful English translation of the source appearance: People offered to a bronze altar have become one with the altar. Its fire has not yet gone out.
PRIORITY: The exact source subject and material override every reference subject. References show pixel technique only. Do not copy their puppet anatomy, brass armor, face plates, smoke vents, or accessories into an enemy that is not described with those features. Use the stated source anatomy and stated props visibly. All mandatory source props must be readable in the silhouette. No readable letters; source inscriptions are tiny abstract marks.
